newsitem.title: USA: Odwalla to cover victim medical expenses.
newsitem.headline: Odwalla to cover victim medical expenses.

text.p: Odwalla Inc executives said on Thursday they would pay the medical expenses of any victims of an E. coli outbreak linked to the company's juice.

At a news conference in the parking lot of the company's headquarters, Odwalla chief executive officer Stephen Williamson said the company had product liability insurance that he believed covered its exposure in the case.
He and company Chairman Greg Steltenpohl declined to comment on the possible cost of the outbreak of bacterial disease and the company's recall of most of its products.
"In all honesty we have not thought about that," Steltenpohl said, saying the company was focused on the health and safety of its customers.

Williamson said the company's entire distribution network had been dedicated to recalling the affected products since Washington state officials linked at least 10 cases of E. coli to Odwalla apple juice.
Odwalla stock plunged 6-1/4 to 12-1/8 in heavy Nasdaq trading.
